quarterly_data.signal: Board of Directors resolutions of August 11, 2026: to meet long-term capacity plans based on market demand forecasts and TSMC's technology development roadmap, the board approved capital appropriations of approximately US$29,442.50 million, mainly for installation and upgrade of advanced technology capacity; installation and upgrade of advanced packaging, mature and/or specialty technology capacity; and fab construction and installation of fab facility systems.
